stories.title: Nvidia Opens Investigation Into Jensen Huang’s Relationship With Suspected Chinese Spy
stories.summary: Nvidia has launched an investigation into its CEO, Jensen Huang, regarding his connection with a business executive. This executive was identified by U.S. officials as working for Chinese intelligence, and Mr. Huang confirmed their close relationship.

stories.title: Anthropic unveils faster, cheaper Claude AI models as it gears up for mega IPO
stories.summary: Anthropic has introduced new Claude AI models that are faster and more affordable. This release comes as the company prepares for a significant initial public offering.

stories.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
stories.summary: ChatGPT Enterprise is now accessible via AWS Marketplace. This integration allows organizations to streamline their purchasing processes by utilizing their existing AWS billing and purchasing agreements.

stories.title: 'We Don't Want Nationalist Support': Deepinder Goyal Says Temple Is Made For The World, Not India
stories.summary: Deepinder Goyal has defended his Temple wearable device against criticism from medical professionals regarding its scientific validity. He stated that Temple is designed for a global audience, not just India, with Entropy being its primary focus.

stories.title: How AI is changing India’s manufacturing sector
stories.summary: Artificial intelligence is bringing about changes in India's manufacturing industry.

stories.title: Nvidia’s Stock Price Drops After Investigation Into CEO Jensen Huang
stories.summary: Nvidia's stock price dropped significantly after its CEO, Jensen Huang, disclosed a relationship with a businesswoman suspected of spying for China. This admission led to a sharp decline in the chip maker's shares.

stories.title: Oil Prices Fall on Hopes for Peace Between U.S. and Iran
stories.summary: Oil prices have fallen, with the global benchmark price decreasing by about $20 a barrel since late October. This decline is attributed to hopes for peace between the U.S. and Iran.

stories.title: HSBC Raises India Equity Rating, Trims China Outlook Amid Shifting Market Views
stories.summary: HSBC has increased its rating for Indian equities to 'overweight,' indicating greater confidence in that market. Conversely, the bank has lowered its outlook for Chinese equities to 'neutral,' reflecting a shift in market views.

stories.title: U.S. Commerce Dept. Inquiry Into Megaspeed Was Halted After Nvidia Intervention
stories.summary: An investigation by the U.S. Commerce Department into Megaspeed, a company acquiring advanced Nvidia A.I. chips, was transferred to the Justice Department. This change occurred after a senior Nvidia executive contacted Commerce Department officials.

stories.title: Nifty50 to hit 28,000 in 2027? 3 factors that could drive Dalal street's next run
stories.summary: The Nifty50 is projected to reach 28,000 by 2027, driven by several factors. These include optimistic earnings forecasts, lower crude oil prices, and increased investment from foreign portfolio investors, all contributing to a strong outlook for Indian equities.

stories.title: Thomas Massie Moves to Force Vote on Impeaching Pete Hegseth
stories.summary: Representative Thomas Massie has initiated a process to force a vote on impeaching Pete Hegseth. This action means the House must vote on the charges by Wednesday, and if approved, it would lead to a trial in the Senate.

stories.title: What Democrats Plan to Investigate After Election Victory
stories.summary: Democrats are planning extensive investigations into President Trump, his family, and his administration after their recent election victories. A congressional reporter has identified some of the key areas Democrats intend to target with these inquiries.

stories.title: Democrats Demand Answers on Trump’s A.I. Policy Amid Spy Plot
stories.summary: Congressional leaders are seeking information regarding President Trump's artificial intelligence policy. This demand comes as Nvidia investigates its chief executive's alleged involvement with a suspected Chinese spy, raising concerns among Democrats.

stories.title: Diwali is 'Eid of joy', says Kharge; Congress insulting Sanatan culture: BJP
stories.summary: The BJP states that the Congress party is insulting Sanatan culture, while Kharge refers to Diwali as the 'Eid of joy'.

stories.title: Merger speculations script confusion within NCP, MLAs seek clarity from top leadership
stories.summary: Speculation about a merger is causing confusion within the NCP, leading MLAs to seek clarification from their top leadership.

stories.title: USCIS mandates new I-129 form for all work visa petitions from 9 November
stories.summary: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services announced that a new version of the I-129 form will be required for all work visa petitions starting November 9. This change affects the standard documentation process for employers submitting work visa applications.

stories.title: ACE, Others Call on DHS to Withdraw Proposed OPT Fee Increase
stories.summary: Educational groups, including ACE, have requested that the Department of Homeland Security cancel its planned fee increases for the Optional Practical Training program. Halting these fee adjustments is intended to prevent added financial burdens for international students and employers.

stories.title: United States: DOL Final Rule on Prevailing Wages Now Under OMB Review
stories.summary: The Department of Labor's final rule concerning prevailing wages is currently undergoing review by the Office of Management and Budget. This review is a key step before the new wage regulations can be officially implemented.

stories.title: DHS Targets 60-Day H-1B Grace Period. Can Texas Firms Replace U.S. Workers With Visa Holders?
stories.summary: The Department of Homeland Security is focusing on the sixty-day grace period for H-1B visa holders, raising questions regarding whether Texas companies can substitute domestic employees with visa workers. This scrutiny highlights ongoing debates about foreign labor practices and worker displacement.

stories.title: The Finish Line Keeps Moving for H-4 EAD Applicants
stories.summary: Applicants for H-4 Employment Authorization Documents continue to face shifting timelines and prolonged delays in the processing of their work permits. These ongoing procedural hurdles create uncertainty for dependent spouses seeking employment authorization.
